title: Customers Create & Edit allows creating customers, contacts and vehicles
custom_preconds: 1. A user has a role with Customers View and Create & Edit, and View and Manage AP/AR Data ON.
custom_steps:
1. Open Customers and create a new customer.
  2. Fill the basic fields and save.
  3. Add a contact.
  4. Add a vehicle.
  5. Edit existing customer info.
evidence: UI (role with Customers Create&Edit = Service Advisor): the /customers list shows the New Customer create control; a customer without customersDelete shows no Delete. Create customers/contacts/vehicles is enabled by Customers Create&Edit. screenshot cust-SAce.
